:::{#thm-irreducible-risk-cond-variance}
#### The residual risk is the expected conditional variance

Let $\Predvar$ and $\Outvar$ be as in @thm-best-predictor.
Then the [residual risk](#def-irreducible-risk) is the [expectation](#def-expectation) of the [conditional variance](#def-cond-variance) of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar$:

$$
\popriskf{\truemean} = \E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}.
$$ {#eq-irreducible-risk-cond-variance}

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\popriskf{\truemean}
&= \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\truemean}}}
&& \text{(definition of the residual risk)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{\truemeanf{\Predvar} - \Outvar}}
&& \text{(definition of the prediction error)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{\Outvar - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}}
&& \text{(a square is unchanged by negation)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{\Outvar - \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}}
&& \text{(definition of } \truemean \text{)} \\
&= \E{\condE{\sqf{\Outvar - \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}}{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(law of total expectation)} \\
&= \E{\Var{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(definition of conditional variance)}
\ea
$$

:::
